name: GW Ranch Waha Gas Pipeline

values.DataCenterNotes: The same news story ties the GW Ranch campus, which the pipeline supplies, to a hyperscale data center.

researcher_notes: No existing row matches this line. Pacifico Energy is developing the off-grid GW Ranch power and data center campus in Pecos County, Texas. A trade news story from January 2026 names a 15-mile pipeline to the Waha hub as one of the project's gas connections and ties the campus to a hyperscale data center. Under the data center rule, a named sponsor, a named project in a known state and a public announcement are enough. The owner is not named, so Owner is blank. Pacifico Energy is the developer but no source says it will own the pipeline. Capacity is blank because the one story we could read does not state it, though other coverage mentions 1 billion cubic feet per day. The start point is the campus, not a surveyed point. No route is published. The Texas air permit covers the power plant only, and no Railroad Commission pipeline filing was found. Confidence is low.
